text:
Predicates:
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
WorkingTitle(y, z) ::: y had working title z.
Series(y) ::: y is a series.
MemberOf(z, y) ::: z is a member of series y.
Premises:
Series(badults) ::: Badults is a series.
MemberOf(pappys, badults) ::: Members of Pappy's starred in Badults.
WorkingTitle(badults, "The Secret Dude Society") ::: The working title of Badults was "The Secret Dude Society".
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, y) ∧ WorkingTitle(y, "The Secret Dude Society") ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
